limitations: Covers UI-covered employment only; excludes self-employed, federal civilian, and certain agricultural workers.
State-level series; county-level QCEW exists (ENU15001*, ENU15003*, etc.) but is noisier on small-county wage means.
Average pay is total wages / employment — top-coding effects from a thin tail of high earners can move the mean by 1-2% in any year.
Reported on calendar year basis; trailing revisions through Q3 of year+1 are common (typically <0.5%).
QCEW is *nominal* wages; real wage growth is the relevant comparison for ACS B19013 (also nominal).

Replaced in full on 2026-10 from the BLS API: the January 2026 file agreed within 1% through 2019, then ran 2-5% low (2020 growth +3.9% against QCEW's +10.0%, a pandemic composition effect), and its series id was monthly employment.
series_id: ENU1500050010 (Hawaii statewide, all industries, total covered, average annual pay)
title: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages — Hawaii statewide annual average pay (all ownership, all industries)
units: USD per covered employee per year (nominal)
